name: AgiBot World 2026
summary: 真实场景多视角机器人操作数据，带步骤、成功帧、错误原因和失败恢复标注。
summaryEn: A real-scene multiview robot-manipulation dataset with step, success-frame, error-cause, and recovery annotations.
licenseZh: 见 Hugging Face 数据条款
access: Dataset available on Hugging Face and official site
accessZh: 数据集已在 Hugging Face 和官方网站提供
verdict: 包含错误、干预和恢复状态的大规模真机操作轨迹
verdictEn: Large-scale real-robot trajectories with error, intervention, and recovery states
wmNote: 步骤级动作和恢复关键帧适合训练长时状态转移模型。
wmNoteEn: Step-level actions and recovery keyframes support long-horizon transition models.
